title: Senior Sustainability Manager - Circular Systems and Innovation
description:
**Your role @ CHANEL**

CHANEL is committed to advancing sustainability with the ambition to be exemplary. As sustainability priorities and reporting expectations continue to evolve, including circular economy and resource-use requirements, the House is strengthening the way circularity is embedded across markets and business activities.

Based in Hong Kong SAR or Singapore and reporting to the Director Sustainability NA & SEAA, the Senior Sustainability Manager - Circular Systems and Innovation will play a key role in advancing CHANEL’s sustainability agenda, in the region with a focus on circularity, waste management, materials, and reporting readiness.

Acting as a subject matter expert and transformation partner, the role will translate circularity ambitions into practical roadmaps, governance, data foundations, partnerships, and operating practices. The position will support regional, divisional, and market action plans while strengthening circularity capability, evidence quality, and scalable approaches to resource use and end-of-life management.

**The impact you can create at CHANEL**

* Translate circularity ambitions into clear regional priorities, market roadmaps and practical implementation plans.
* Support the integration of circularity principles into business planning, procurement, operations, materials and resource-use decisions.
* Lead a portfolio of circularity initiatives from concept to implementation, ensuring progress, collaboration and business relevance.
* Develop practical guidance, tools and ways of working that help teams make informed decisions on circular design, use, reuse, recovery and responsible end-of-life pathways.
* Strengthen circularity data, performance tracking, evidence quality and reporting readiness in partnership with relevant teams.
* Build trusted partnerships with internal stakeholders and external experts to identify, assess and scale circularity solutions.
* Facilitate learning across markets, divisions and functions to build capability and embed circularity as a shared business responsibility.
* Monitor emerging circularity trends, expectations and regulations to help the organisation anticipate future requirements and adapt ways of working accordingly.

**You are energized by…**

* Turning complex and emerging sustainability topics into clear, actionable and measurable steps.
* Working across functions, markets and cultures to connect people, ideas and expertise.
* Building the systems, capabilities and relationships that make circularity practical and adopted by the business.
* Balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and continuous improvement.
* Contributing to a purpose-led House where creativity, quality and long-term impact matter.

**What you can bring to the team…**

* Tertiary level academic qualifications in a relevant field; advanced degree or certification in sustainability is a plus.
* 8+ years of proven experience and track record in project management, circular economy principles, environmental impact assessment, life cycle analysis, materials expertise and sustainable business practices.
* Proven experience working in complex, matrixed organizations with global and regional stakeholders, facilitating
* Comfort working with data, performance indicators and qualitative insights to support decision-making.
* Experience collaborating in complex, matrixed organisations with regional, local and global stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills in English.
* Strong business acumen, structured problem-solving, learning agility and a collaborative mindset.
* Positive mindset and passion for circularity and the ability to make sustainability credible, practical and inspiring for others.

**What you will learn / What CHANEL can offer you…**

* Exposure to a unique House with a rich brand, culture and business environment.
* The opportunity to contribute to sustainability transformation across diverse markets and functions.
* A regional platform to shape circularity capabilities, partnerships and ways of working.
* A collaborative environment that values long-term thinking, personal growth and collective progress.

At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth and contributes to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

title: Senior Asst Director (Standards, Reporting and Assurance), SingHealth Office for Sustainable Health
description:
Job Category: Administration

Posting Date: 31 Jul 2026

Join SingHealth's Office for Sustainable Health (OSH) and play a pivotal role in shaping how Singapore's largest public healthcare cluster measures, reports, and advances its sustainability commitments. You will work at the intersection of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategy, data governance, and stakeholder engagement — contributing directly to the national ESG reporting framework for Singapore's public healthcare sector.

We are seeking a Senior Assistant Director to lead the development of robust ESG data reporting systems and internal controls, and to prepare disclosures that meet global standards whilst aligning with national frameworks. Reporting to the Group Director of OSH, with matrix reporting to the Deputy Group Chief Financial Officer, you will work closely with Finance and Risk Management teams as well as institutional partners across SingHealth to ensure that sustainability data is accurate, meaningful, and audit-ready.

**What You Will Do:**

You will develop and implement a cluster-wide sustainability data collection system and internal controls framework, with the goal of establishing a validated, audit-ready baseline and enabling prospective tracking across all SingHealth institutions

Working in close collaboration with the Finance and Risk Management teams, you will integrate financial and social metrics into ESG disclosures, ensuring consistency and alignment between SingHealth's Financial Report and its ESG report as part of the Ministry of Health (MOH)-led collective reporting for the public healthcare sector. You will coordinate with all SingHealth institutions to meet MOH-mandated milestones for data submission, managing timelines and escalating critical decisions to senior leadership where appropriate.

You will regularly review and assess sustainability-related risks and opportunities, working with internal stakeholders to support prioritisation of action plans and track material ESG topics that align with SingHealth's mission, strategic goals, and commitments to the communities it serves. Insights drawn from tracked data will be shared in a timely manner to support care improvement and strategic transformation across the cluster.

Supporting the SingHealth governance framework for sustainability, you will ensure transparency and accuracy in outcome reporting. You will also supervise one direct report to provide guidance and direction as the team's work matures.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Sustainability Management, or related fields
* An accounting background with professional accounting certification such as Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or equivalent is preferred
* At least 12 years of relevant work experience, with prior experience in the healthcare sector or in healthcare or environmental regulatory agencies being an advantage
* Demonstrated experience in financial reporting, internal controls, or sustainability reporting with a focus on risk management or integrated reporting
* Experience in implementing digital tools or software solutions for data automation in a reporting or analytics context, including working knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI is preferred.
* Team player with strong collaboration skills and ability to work independently
* A genuine passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to driving meaningful, positive change

description:
### **DBS Foundation, Business for Impact Team**

DBS Foundation is committed to uplifting lives and livelihoods by helping vulnerable communities across Asia become more socially and financially resilient. In its next decade, the Foundation is sharpening its focus on addressing essential needs, fostering financial inclusion, and nurturing innovative Businesses for Impact that improve the social and financial resilience of vulnerable communities.

The Business for Impact team focuses on supporting and scaling social enterprises and SMEs that use business as a force for good. Through grants, awards, capacity-building programmes, and partnerships across the DBS ecosystem and broader impact sector, the team nurtures purpose-driven businesses, strengthening their commercial models while deepening their impact on communities in need.

This role requires someone who can bridge impact and business: a candidate with experience in social impact, grantmaking or ecosystem building, combined with strong business acumen, the ability to assess business models, and the strategic thinking required to develop and execute impactful initiatives. The individual should be comfortable working with founders, investors, internal business teams and external stakeholders to scale impact.

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead and support DBS Foundation’s Business for Impact initiatives, including grants, awards and capacity-building programmes for social enterprises and other Businesses for Impact.
* Identify and assess Businesses for Impact with innovative, financially sustainable and scalable models that improve the social and financial resilience of vulnerable communities across Asia.
* Apply both an impact and business lens to evaluate applicants and portfolio enterprises, including their impact thesis, beneficiary outcomes, commercial viability, revenue model, leadership quality, growth strategy and ability to scale.
* Design and deliver support for Businesses for Impact, including mentorship, learning opportunities, market access, ecosystem connections and partnerships with DBS business units, clients and employee volunteers.
* Build strong relationships with external and internal stakeholders to create opportunities for collaboration.
* Track portfolio performance and impact outcomes, working with partners to strengthen measurement, reporting and insights that inform funding decisions and programme improvements.
* Support advocacy, content and engagement initiatives to inspire others to create impact.

### **Requirements**

* Recognised degree in Business, Finance, Social Impact, Public Policy, Communications, Technology or other relevant disciplines.
* Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience in grantmaking, venture philanthropy, impact investing, SME/start-up ecosystems, consulting, finance, business development, or related fields.
* Good understanding of impact models, beneficiary outcomes, impact measurement and the challenges faced by vulnerable communities, especially in areas such as essential needs, financial inclusion, employability, healthcare, education, nutrition and ageing.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to assess business models, financial sustainability, revenue drivers, market opportunity, scalability and leadership capability.
* Experience working with social enterprises, SMEs, start-ups, investors, accelerators, incubators, or ecosystem partners will be an advantage.
* Purpose-driven, resourceful and comfortable operating in a lean team, with the independence to manage multiple priorities and the judgement to engage senior internal and external stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business and impact considerations into clear recommendations, reports and stakeholder communications.

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Product Management (Sustainability and Financial Inclusion)Overview:
  
  
At Mastercard, we are focused on building an inclusive, sustainable digital economy, where everyone has an opportunity to reach their potential. We see firsthand how our commitment to environmental and social responsibility - and our core value of operating ethically and responsibly and with decency - is directly connected to our continuing success as a business. We recognize that Mastercard cannot succeed in a failing world. We thrive when economies thrive, and a successful economy is sustainable only when it is inclusive and when prosperity is shared.  
  
We are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all by focusing on the following key areas of impact:
  
  
Environmental Stewardship: Responsibly managing our environmental footprint and creating environmentally conscious solutions  
  
Inclusive Growth: Creating a more inclusive world through our products, programs, and partnerships  
  
Our People and Culture: Leveraging our core values to make our company the place where the best people choose to be  
  
Ethical and Responsible Standards: Acting responsibly and with integrity guided by the highest standards of ethical behavior  
  
The Role:
  
  

* As a Manager for Sustainability and Financial Inclusion, you will join the Sustainability team and be responsible for reinforcing our sustainability and business strategy. This role will be based in Singapore.

  

* The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and coordinating Mastercard’s product/commercial Sustainability activities for the Asia Pacific region. The role requires the individual to possess a strong combination of strategic, commercial, project and product management mindset. You will handle product integration/deployment and have a thorough understanding of product details for new as well as existing products & services.

  

* You will play an active role in launching and monitoring product/program performance, scaling and driving adoption, as it relates to Sustainability and Financial Inclusion initiatives relating to Priceless Planet Coalition, Carbon Calculator and connecting 500 million people and small businesses to digital pathways that promote long-term resilience across AP. As part of these initiatives, you will collaborate and coordinate across Divisions/Markets, Region and Global.

  

* You will help shape and advance Mastercard’s regional sustainability and financial inclusion agenda by driving strategic insights, impact measurement, and performance visibility across key initiatives. This includes supporting the tracking and articulation of outcomes related to financial inclusion and financial health priorities, alongside sustainability programs such as Priceless Planet Coalition and the Mastercard Carbon Calculator.

  

* Working closely with cross functional teams, market stakeholders, and external partners, you will help translate data, market intelligence, and program outcomes into meaningful business and impact narratives that support strategic decision making, regional priorities, stakeholder engagement, and long-term growth objectives.

  

* The role requires you to have a continual look at the market & track competition, to see how our products can be improved to meet the evolving needs of the end-consumers & to bench mark our products with that of competition.

  
  
All About You:
  
  

* Strong knowledge of, and interest in, sustainability, financial inclusion, financial health, or related fields, with the ability to understand emerging market trends, stakeholder priorities, and the evolving business landscape shaping these agendas.

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to develop executive-ready briefings, presentations, and strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  

* Able to navigate, influence, and lead cross functional collaboration across diverse stakeholders and functions, with comfort operating in ambiguous and fast evolving environments while delivering clear outcomes.

  

* Proven project management and execution capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, drive coordination across internal and external stakeholders, and deliver against key timelines and priorities.

  

* Competent in leading product solutioning and technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders, with experience supporting the launch and scaling of products or services across one or multiple markets.

  

* Exceptional analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to build robust business cases that clearly articulate the incremental value and impact of our solutions for customers and Mastercard.

  

* Ability to conduct financial and cost-benefit analyses to support strategic decision making, product enhancements, and internal investment approvals.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
